abstract: From 1966-1982, 138 previously untreated patients with metastatic malignant gestational trophoblastic disease received primary chemotherapy at the Southeastern Regional Trophoblastic Disease Center. Fifty-six (41%) had poor-prognosis metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease, and 51 (91%) of these patients were initially treated with multiagent chemotherapy. Sustained remissions were achieved in 128 patients (93%). Patients who had metastatic involvement of more than one anatomic site, disease duration of greater than four months, antecedent nonmolar pregnancy, or clinicopathologic diagnosis of choriocarcinoma were at significantly increased risk for failure to achieve sustained remission compared with patients who lacked these clinical features. Initial human chorionic gonadotropin level and site of metastasis had no significant effect on survival in these previously untreated patients. Patients with disease duration of greater than four months who had an antecedent nonmolar pregnancy were at significantly increased risk, with only 12 of 20 (60%) surviving, versus all of 85 patients with short duration of disease and antecedent molar pregnancy, and 32 (94%) of 34 patients with other combinations of these factors (P less than .001). Initial therapy for patients with metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease should be selected on the basis of prognostic factors that predict a high probability of failure with single-agent chemotherapy alone. Patients with prolonged duration of disease and nonmolar antecedent gestation are at high risk for failure using traditional forms of methotrexate and actinomycin D-based combination chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 1966年から1982年の間に、南東地域妊娠性絨毛性疾患センターにおいて、未治療の転移性悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者138例が初回化学療法を受けた。56例（41%）が予後不良の転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患であり、このうち51例（91%）が当初多剤併用化学療法を受けた。128例（93%）で持続寛解が得られた。複数の解剖学的部位への転移、4か月を超える罹病期間、非胞状奇胎の先行妊娠、または絨毛癌と臨床病理学的に診断された患者は、これらの臨床的特徴がない患者と比べて、持続寛解の達成に失敗するリスクが有意に高かった。初診時のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値と転移部位は、これら未治療患者の生存に有意な影響を与えなかった。罹病期間が4か月を超え、先行妊娠が非胞状奇胎であった患者はリスクが有意に高く、20例中12例（60%）のみが生存していた。一方、罹病期間が短く先行妊娠が胞状奇胎であった85例はすべて生存しており、その他の因子の組み合わせを持つ34例中32例（94%）も生存していた（P < .001）。転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の初期治療は、単剤化学療法のみでは失敗する確率が高いと予測される予後因子に基づいて選択すべきである。罹病期間が長く、非胞状奇胎の先行妊娠を有する患者は、従来のメトトレキサートおよびアクチノマイシンDを基盤とした併用化学療法では失敗するリスクが高い。
